# Artemis II lifts off from Kennedy Space Center

NASA's Orion spacecraft launched atop the Space Launch System rocket on the first crewed mission of the agency's Artemis campaign.

The Artemis II test flight launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The mission will send NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen on a journey around the Moon and back to Earth.
